verdict.rationale: Open WebUI exposes an API that external code can call with API keys, so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found 404s on every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on the docs site. The llms.txt index is machine-readable documentation, not an API spec, and the OpenAI-compatible gateway is a related capability rather than a published spec, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
